verdict.rationale: Rootly documents retrospective templates with AI blocks that can be previewed against past incidents. It auto-drafts sections, including Curated Timeline, from incident data, Slack and transcripts, and offers a collaborative editor. Workflows can start retros automatically, and multiple processes can be routed by severity, so a SEV0 gets full formal treatment and a SEV3 a lightweight review. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of review/approval stages and a publication step (only export to an external editor is mentioned), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
